fields.title: 📖 an-Nisāʾ 4:105: Judging by what Allah has shown
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“We sent down the Book to you with the truth, so that you may judge between the people by what Allah has shown you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The standard of the Ḥukm is revelation, not desire, tribal interest, bribery, or man-made arbitrariness.
